comments.body: Product signed off on 80% as the sole threshold for v1 — no multi-tier warnings yet.

content.text: Product signed off on 80% as the sole threshold for v1 — no multi-tier warnings yet.
Hard 429s at 100% of the hourly quota surprise clients that could have shed load earlier. Several partners asked for a predictive signal before the hard ceiling.
When usage crosses 80% of the hourly budget, include RateLimit-Warning: 80-percent with remaining and reset timestamps on otherwise successful responses. Do not change status codes or body shapes.

Acceptance: warning appears only on authenticated routes that already emit RateLimit-Remaining; warning clears after the window rolls; documented in the public rate-limit guide; feature-flagged for a one-week canary.
